$comment: Module settings for the sticker generator. Each stickers/<name>.uid is a sticker body; its sibling stickers/<name>.json lists its variant cells (UI builder operations applied before export) and `pairs`, the hand-written sticker each shell replaces, for compare-local.py. wear-m3's copy is knob strings (`kitCopy`), not string resources, so there is no `stringResources` accessor.
